review_scope.negative_sampling: per talk: six threshold-nearest non-candidates plus six deterministic hash-random non-candidates

positive_review.interpretation: The positive set is useful as a high-precision change inventory, including incremental slide reveals.

negative_review.interpretation: The stratified sample is not an unbiased error-rate estimate, but it contains unambiguous missed changes. Pixel thresholds are therefore invalid for causal state compression.

unambiguous_missed_examples.reason: full slide change from Retrieval to Generation
full slide change to model architecture input
full slide change from composition to sentence encoding

frozen_v1_decision.availability: Each frame is unavailable before its filename timestamp and remains current only until the next observed frame.
frozen_v1_decision.transition_candidates_role: diagnostic high-precision inventory only; never used to backdate or compress v1 inference states
